article.story: BOULDER, Colo. -- — Jaxon Olvera scored 22 points, backup RJ Nance Jr. added 14 and Portland upset Colorado 77-74 on Wednesday night. Hunter Adam added 13 points for the Pilots, who shot 28 of 56. Justin Neely scored 27 points on 9-of-12 shooting overall and 8-of-9 shooting from the foul line for Colorado. Noah Feddersen scored 14 points and Jalin Holland 12 for the Buffs, who were a paltry 5 of 31 from beyond the arc. Portland led 65-55 with 7:38 left after a 3-pointer from Dante Censori-Hercules before Colorado made its last push. The Buffs used an 11-6 run in the last 2:21 to get within the final margin, but Neely and Alex Dickeson each missed 3s on Colorado's final possession. It was Portland's (4-2) first win against Colorado (2-3) in four tries. Up next Portland: Hosts Fordham on Saturday. Colorado: Hosts Stanford on Tuesday. ------ This story has been corrected to remove incorrect references to Portland being in the Big Sky Conference and to correct the spelling of Alex Dickeson. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here.
